text.body: || śrīḥ || śrīmadānandatīrthabhāgavatatpādapraṇītasarvamūlagranthāḥ tithinirṇayaḥ|| śrīmaddhanumadbhīmamadhvāntargatarāmakṛṣṇavedavyāsātmakaśrīlakṣmīhayagrīvāya namaḥ || viṣṇuṃ viśveśvaraṃ natvā tadupoṣaṇaśuddhaye | mūlagranthānusāreṇa kriyate tithinirṇayaḥ || 1 || bhūśrībhinnākicintyo nāt kalyabdāt kālavarddhitāt | garuḍadhyeyavākyāptaṃ tyaktvā sauraṃ vṛthāphalam || 2 || rāśayādyaṃ maddhyamaṃ kuryād goghnād dhīsūnunāgajāḥ | kalāstyaktvā dhruvaṃ kuryād deśādhāraharārcakam || 3 || anantavṛddhād baudhāṅgatulye nenduḥ śukāhatāt | prājñāñjalibhṛdāptonastāraśobhātinākinā || 4 || dinebhyo rāgarāgāptaścāndrāccaḥ syānnibhāharāt | jagatsenāṅgalabdhonaḥ śreṣṭhacintyombunārcane || 5 || laṅkāsāmyādirekhāyāḥ pūrvapaścimadeśayoḥ | grahaṇāṃ maddhyasaṃskāraliptā ṛṇadhanaṃ kramāt || 6 || pāpaghnādadhvasaṅkhyānādarkkalabdhaviliptikāḥ | arkkadorjyophalācchuddhā yathārke tatphalā tathā || 7 || arkadorjyāphalācchuddhāt yatha'rke tatphalāt tathā goghnadivyaprajābhyāṃ ca viliptāścandanābjayoḥ || 8 || deśadoḥśuddhaye dānakṣviṣṇudyāṃ syurviliptikāḥ | uccaṃ sūryasya niyataṃ dṛṣṭā strībhāgarāśayaḥ || 9 || śarīranut dhībhavanaḥ kathañcano nalījano mānapaṭuḥ śukālayaḥ | nirāmayo dhīḥpathiko ...budhonaraḥ suptaparaḥ kalāvirāṭ || 10 || mahāśaro dūrasaro dhamīhariḥ hasandhuro vedanagaḥ susaṅkulaḥ | tamaḥkhagāḥ pārabalaṃ rasābalaṃ dhanāvaliḥ kārabhṛgurjagadbhagaḥ || 11 || imāścaturviṃśatijyāḥ sphuṭatvāyārkasomayoḥ | caturviṃśativākyāni trirāśīnāmimān viduḥ || 12 || śubhāṅgaparimāṇena yadi jyārddhaṃ na pūryate | varttamānajyayā hitvā murāruphalasaṅgrahaḥ || 13 || rāśicakraṃ catuṣpādayojanodvipādayoḥ | atītānāgatau bhāgau bhuja ityucyate budhaiḥ || 14 || socconārkābjayorddorjyo gosadbhyāṃ varddhitāḥ kramāt | ajalabdhakarāḥ svasvagolayoḥ saṛṇaṃ dhanam || 15 || tadekadinagā liptā grahāṇāṃ svasvabhuktayaḥ | kalyabdaugho dhenubhavo yuktaḥ saurairvṛthāphalaiḥ | etasmānmāpatelabdhaṃ rāśyādyāyanamucyate || 16 || prabhāratnaṃ dhīsavanaṃ gānasthānaṃ janendhanam | dehinityaṃ sugaprāyaṃ sāvalokyaṃ taṭidvapuḥ || 17 || navabhāryeti vākyāni jño'nantoṛtuhārakaḥ | taddorjyāliptikā bhānau yuktvā tyaktvā'tha golayoḥ || 18 || arkapūjyādivākyoktadorviliptāścaroditāḥ | arkaḥ pūjyaḥ sudhākāro ratikrīḍo nutaḥ prabhuḥ || 19 || alaṅkṛṣṇo hitoddeśo gatibhūtaḥ smarājitaḥ | śaśidhāteti vākyāni jñonanto'tra tu hārakaḥ || 20 || tadekadinagā liptā grahāṇāṃ svasvabhuktayaḥ | carārddhāt svasvabhuktighnādanantāṅgahṛtāḥ kalāḥ | ṛṇaṃ prātarddhanaṃ sāyamuttare dakṣiṇe'nyathā || 21 || deśāntaradorvivarajasaṃskāravidhirvidhīyate madhye | caradalasaṃskāravidhiḥ sphuṭakriyānantaraṃ sadbhiḥ || 22 || saddhiḥ candrāt pūrvoktasaṃskārakṛtād dinapatiṃ tyajet | śeṣaṃ ṣaṣṭyā ghaṭībhistu vibhajyāptā gatā tithiḥ || 23 || varttamānadvādaśabhirliprikābhiharettithim | gātāstu nāḍikā jñeyāḥ śiṣṭā liptāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 24 || ekā'tidvādaśīvṛddhau no ced vṛddhau tu ṣoḍaśa | dvyekaliptī same hnāse catuṣkāduttaraṃ tvidam || 25 || ativṛddhāvaṣṭayugaṃ vṛddhāvaṣṭa same catuḥ | dvyekaliptī same hnāse catuṣkāduttaraṃ tvidam || 26 || udavyavyāpinī darśā paurṇṇamāsī tu vārāhe iti vidhya | maddhyāhṛnavyāpinī śroṇā upoṣyā viṣṇutatparaiḥ || 27 || upavāsaphalaprepsurjjahyād bhuktacatuṣṭayam | pūrvāpare tu sāyāhne sāmayampratastu maddhyame || 28 || kalārddhaṃ dvādaśīṃ dṛṣṭvā niśīthādūrdhvameva tu | āmaddhyāhnāḥ kriyāḥ sarvāḥ karttavyāḥ śambhuśāsanāt || 29 || || iti śrīmadānandatīrthabhagavatpādaviracitaḥ tithinirṇayaḥ samāptaḥ ||
